predecessors.name: Ceylon (Sinhalese kingdoms)
predecessors.text: the Kotte area and the Colombo hinterland: Colombo, Gampaha and Kalutara districts

successors.name: Portuguese Ceylon
successors.text: Kotte, ceded to the Portuguese crown on 27 May 1597

ledger.x: 1507: the Kotte kingdom stands on its own beside Portuguese Ceylon.
1509: 'Parakramabahu IX moved the capital to Kelaniya in 1509, where it stayed until 1528.'
1521: the Principality of Raigama is the third part of the division.
By 1564: 'most of the areas of Kotte Kingdom were annexed to the Kingdom of Sitawaka'.
1565: 'In 1565, the capital of Kotte was abandoned by' Dharmapala because of attacks from Sitawaka; he 'was taken to Colombo under Portuguese protection'.
1594: 'After Sitawaka fell in 1594, these areas were re-annexed to the Kotte kingdom.'
27 May 1597: 'Dharmapala formally ceded the Kotte Kingdom to the Portuguese crown'; the Kotte era ends.

wars.name: Division of Kotte and the Sitawaka wars
wars.outcome: Bhuvanekabahu sought Portuguese help against Mayadunne; Sitawaka annexed most of Kotte by 1564 and Dharmapala left for Colombo in 1565; Kotte lands were re-annexed after 1594.

certainty.note: The page gives no extent for Kotte before the division of 1521 or after it; the lowlands round Colombo are my reading.
Colombo only is drawn; the page says 'most of the areas' were Sitawaka's, in no year.
